links.comparator_used: Baseline prompting with no assigned physician persona
links.outcome: Rate of affirmative ("Yes") answers on binary clinical action decisions (safety, autonomy, treatment, resource use, follow-up) under fixed clinical evidence
links.effect: Baseline 42.8% Yes; persona prompts shifted affirmative rates from 36.9% to 46.4%, a 9.5-percentage-point swing; largest in autonomy and treatment; 85.7% directional agreement across corpora, r = 0.82 for effect sizes
links.tradeoff: Personas shift clinical action thresholds with the clinical facts unchanged, so the prompt acts as a policy-setting layer; susceptibility varied by model (4.9–16.1 points). No accuracy outcome was reported.
links.quote: Persona prompts shifted affirmative rates from 36.9% to 46.4%, a 9.5–percentage-point swing under fixed clinical evidence.
